findings.title: Fragile timestamp-only ID generation causes primary key collisions in `clio_write::triple::triple_add`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/triple.rs:136-137: `let edge_id = format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp); let item_id = format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp);`
findings.requirement_ref: Phase 100080 Specification § Task 2 / FR-12; sql/001_core.sql primary key constraints
findings.recommendation: Include entropy, monotonic counter, or UUID in edge_id and item_id to prevent collision when multiple triples share a timestamp.
findings.resolution: crates/clio-write/src/triple.rs now generates ids via `unique_id(prefix, timestamp)` = `{prefix}-{timestamp}-{nanos}-{seq}-{pid}` using a process-global `AtomicU64` counter plus nanos and pid. New test `unique_ids_do_not_collide_on_shared_timestamp` proves same-timestamp ids differ.

findings.title: Unindexed full table scan on bank in `query_triples`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple_read.rs:82 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple_read.rs:75: `SELECT ... FROM triples WHERE bank_id = ?1` fetches all bank rows before in-memory filtering
findings.recommendation: Push subject, predicate, and interval query constraints into the SQL query WHERE clause to take advantage of the newly added database indexes.
findings.resolution: Round 2: interval pushdown is now implemented. A single shared builder `query_where_clause` (crates/clio-store/src/triple_map.rs) composes the entire parameterized WHERE clause — bank scope, optional SPO equality, and the half-open axis-interval visibility predicate (`from <= as_of AND (until IS NULL OR as_of < until)` with `as_of` defaulting to wall-clock now) — parameterized per dialect by a placeholder closure (`?i` for SQLite, `$i` for Postgres). Both `sqlite_triple_read.rs` and `postgres_triple_read.rs` use it, so the bank/interval indexes (`triples_bank_id_valid_from_valid_until_inx`, `triples_bank_id_tx_from_tx_until_inx`) are usable and the interval algebra stays written once, in the shared helper, satisfying the Phase 100080 single-source requirement. In-memory `filter_triples` remains applied after fetch as the shared semantic source of truth. New unit test `query_where_clause_pushes_pattern_and_interval_predicates` asserts clause content, parameter order, both axes, and the default-now as_of. Round 3: re-read both call sites (sqlite_triple_read.rs:77, postgres_triple_read.rs:71) and confirmed the interval predicate is present; no code change needed; re-verified by `make check` EXIT=0 and `make coverage` EXIT=0.

findings.title: Flawed 'current' semantics when `as_of` is omitted in `triple_query`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/triple_map.rs:79: `TimeAxis::Valid => t.valid_until.is_none()` returns future edges where valid_from > now
findings.recommendation: When as_of is None, default to the current timestamp (now) so that valid_from <= now < valid_until.
findings.resolution: `filter_triples` (crates/clio-store/src/triple_map.rs) now resolves an omitted `as_of` to wall-clock now and always applies `visible_at(axis, as_of)`, so a future-dated fact (`valid_from > now`) is no longer returned as current. Added `now_iso8601()` (ISO-8601 UTC) in migrate.rs because the existing epoch-millis `now_iso` does not sort against ISO date fixtures. Test `query_object_filter_and_current_semantics` asserts a `9999-01-01` fact is excluded when `as_of` is omitted and returned for an explicit future `as_of`.

findings.title: Open-edge supersession query ignores active edges with bounded valid intervals
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple.rs:95 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple.rs:92: `WHERE ... AND valid_until IS NULL AND tx_until IS NULL`
findings.recommendation: Query open edges by `tx_until IS NULL` and close overlapping edges on both valid and transaction axes.
findings.resolution: Both supersede paths (`sqlite_triple.rs`, `postgres_triple.rs`) select prior edges by `tx_until IS NULL` instead of `valid_until IS NULL AND tx_until IS NULL`, and close them with `valid_until = COALESCE(valid_until, <new valid_from>)` so an existing bounded valid end is preserved rather than extended. `triple_end` in both read modules was aligned to the same rule. Test `supersede_closes_tx_open_bounded_valid_edge` asserts the prior edge's tx_until is closed while its existing valid_until is not extended.

issues.title: Fragile timestamp-only ID generation causes primary key collisions in `clio_write::triple::triple_add`
issues.why_it_matters: Generating IDs as format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp) and format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp) causes primary key collisions when multiple triples are created at the same timestamp tick.
issues.impact: Concurrent or batched triple writes fail with database duplicate key errors.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/triple.rs:136-137: `let edge_id = format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp); let item_id = format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp);`
issues.proposed_fix: Include a random suffix, nano-timestamp, or monotonic counter (e.g., format!("trp-{}-{}", args.timestamp, nonce)) to guarantee uniqueness.

issues.title: Unindexed full table scan on bank in `query_triples`
issues.why_it_matters: Indexes created in Task 1 for subject, predicate, and valid/tx intervals are completely bypassed because SQL queries fetch all bank triples and filter in Rust.
issues.impact: Query performance will degrade linearly O(N) with the number of triples in the bank, wasting memory and database I/O.
issues.proposed_fix: Construct parameterized WHERE clauses in SQL that filter by subject, predicate, and intervals before loading rows into memory.
issues.resolution: Round 2: `query_where_clause` (crates/clio-store/src/triple_map.rs) now pushes pattern equality AND the half-open interval predicate into the parameterized SQL WHERE for both SQLite and Postgres, from one shared builder.

issues.title: Flawed 'current' semantics when `as_of` is omitted in `triple_query`
issues.why_it_matters: Omitting as_of on the valid axis simply checks valid_until.is_none(). Future facts that are not yet valid (valid_from > now) are improperly returned as currently valid.
issues.impact: Callers querying current state receive facts that are not yet effective.
issues.proposed_fix: When as_of is None, default to the current timestamp (now) so that valid_from <= now < valid_until.

issues.title: Open-edge supersession query ignores active edges with bounded valid intervals
issues.why_it_matters: An edge with a defined future expiration (valid_until set) that is still transactionally active (tx_until is null) is skipped by the open-edge supersession query.
issues.impact: Conflicting edges can remain open simultaneously in transaction time if an earlier edge had a bounded valid_until.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple.rs:95 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple.rs:92: `WHERE ... AND valid_until IS NULL AND tx_until IS NULL`
issues.proposed_fix: Query open edges by `tx_until IS NULL` and close overlapping edges accordingly.
